scenario_scope: Intake of Corben Sorenson's From Compression to Forward Transfer as a causal evaluation framework for reusable symbolic knowledge.

cases.decision_rationale: Procedural Memory owns reusable-procedure admission, while the other chapters already own causal evaluation, cost, proof and artifact boundaries, compression, durable admission, recursive improvement, and generalization. The paper sharpens those interfaces without defining a new authority domain.
required_before_drafting: complete Markdown, DOCX, and bibliography review
evidence_transition_preconditions: freeze a claim-specific task distribution, knowledge version, search procedure, verifier, and budget
execute matched absence, placebo, removal, and library-search interventions
retain exact outcomes, complete denominators, and total lifecycle cost
obtain an accepted claim-specific evidence transition
promotion_blockers: no executed comparator-network or bit-vector intervention
no independently checked formalization or external-source review
non_claims: does not establish beneficial forward transfer
does not establish library or search superiority
does not establish universal generalization or recursive improvement

cases.decision_rationale: A standalone chapter would repeat the established procedural-memory, benchmark, economics, proof-envelope, compression, persistence, recursive-improvement, and learning-theory owners.
required_before_drafting: not applicable; integrate through established owners
evidence_transition_preconditions: reconsider ownership only if an implementation reveals a durable service lifecycle absent from current chapters
promotion_blockers: a cross-layer evaluation protocol is not itself a new stack layer
non_claims: does not forbid a later split if a genuinely unowned responsibility appears

validation_boundary: Records a complete-manuscript existing-owner integration and duplicate-chapter rejection. It does not validate the counterexamples, protocols, cost model, transfer effects, cited literature, safety, novelty, or resource advantage.
non_claims: does not add an unrationalized Lean theorem family
does not authorize training, deployment, release, or claim promotion
